d:
An excerpt of Raga Nat Bihag from Ustad Amjad Ali Khan's Double-CD Album, My Inspirations, accompanied by Sandeep Das on Tabla.
This album was inspired by legendary maestros of the past whose music greatly moved and influenced Amjad Ali Khan, notably Ustads Abdul Karim Khan, Faiyaz Khan, Bade Gulam Ali Khan, Amir Khan and many others.
